integrity: The two Python 3 standard-library checkers are included in full. No independent mathematical audit or externally certified formal proof is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The theorem requires girth at least five and cyclic edge-connectivity at least five for finite simple cubic graphs; the computer programs verify three instances, whereas the written proof covers the full family. Possible equivalent historical descriptions under graph-state or isotropic-system terminology remain a priority risk.
title: Minimum odd-neighborhood witnesses in line graphs of cyclically robust cubic graphs
